nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) balanceOf holding token balances; written in transferFrom, batchSend and constructor.
Public nested mapping allowance granting spender approvals; written in approve, transferFrom and constructor.
Constant public decimals = 18 used for supply scaling.
Public totalSupply, set once in the constructor.
Public token name string set in constructor.
Public token symbol string set in constructor.
Private owner address used as the sole access-control principal for delegate and batchSend.
Constant internal UNI router address used as a privileged spender.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; mutates allowance and balances with unchecked subtractions.
Public payable approve that overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function performing address(a).delegatecall(b) with fully attacker-controlled target and calldata.
Owner-only batch transfer loop with unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length and unchecked balance subtraction.
Internal pure Uniswap-style CREATE2 pair address derivation using factory, tokenA, tokenB and an init code hash.
Modifier applied to transferFrom that computes the UNI pair and requires _from or _to to be owner or the derived pair.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, balanceOf and an infinite allowance to the router.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller identity used for access checks and balance/allowance writes.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary attacker supplied code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend (Solidity 0.5 wrap-around, can overflow).
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Parameter _to of transfer, the destination address.
Parameter _value of transfer, the amount forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the debited account checked by the ensure modifier.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, the transferred amount.
Parameter _spender of approve receiving the new allowance.
Parameter _value of approve, the allowance amount written.
Parameter a of delegate, the arbitrary delegatecall target contract.
Parameter b of delegate, the arbitrary calldata passed to delegatecall.
Parameter _tos of batchSend, the recipient address array.
Parameter _value of batchSend, the per-recipient amount multiplied by the array length.
Parameter _from of the ensure modifier compared against owner and the derived UNI pair.
Parameter _to of the ensure modifier compared against owner.
Parameter factory of pairFor, the Uniswap factory address.
Parameter tokenA of pairFor, one side of the pair.
Parameter tokenB of pairFor, the other side of the pair.
Constructor parameter _name assigned to the name state variable.
Constructor parameter _symbol assigned to the symbol state variable.
Constructor parameter _supply scaled by 10**decimals into totalSupply.
Local variable total in batchSend holding the unchecked product _value * _tos.length.
Local loop counter i iterating over the _tos array in batchSend.
Local loop variable _to in batchSend holding the current recipient.
Local variable UNI in the ensure modifier holding the pairFor-derived pair address.
Local variable pair in pairFor holding the derived CREATE2 address.
Local token0 in pairFor, the lexicographically smaller token.
Local token1 in pairFor, the lexicographically larger token.

edges.reason: transfer delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is supplied as the _from argument of transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller identity.
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
Constructor permanently stores owner = msg.sender and grants it the full supply.
Parameter _to of transfer flows into the forwarded transferFrom call.
Parameter _value of transfer flows into the forwarded transferFrom call.
Parameter _from of transferFrom is debited and validated by the ensure modifier.
Parameter _to of transferFrom is credited in balanceOf[_to].
Parameter _value of transferFrom drives allowance and balance mutations.
Parameter _spender of approve indexes the allowance mapping.
Parameter _value of approve is written into the allowance mapping.
Parameter a of delegate selects the delegatecall target.
Parameter b of delegate supplies the raw calldata.
Attacker-controlled address a becomes the target of the privileged delegatecall.
Attacker-controlled bytes b becomes the delegatecall calldata.
delegate executes the unsafe low-level delegatecall while running with owner privileges.
Parameter _tos of batchSend supplies the loop recipients.
Parameter _value of batchSend is used to size the unchecked total and per-recipient credits.
_value is a multiplicand of the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.
_tos.length is the other multiplicand of the unchecked multiplication.
batchSend performs the unchecked multiplication without any overflow guard.
ensure compares its _from parameter against owner and the derived pair address.
ensure compares its _to parameter against owner.
transferFrom is wrapped by the ensure modifier whose checks decide whether the body executes.
ensure reads the privileged owner state variable to authorize _from/_to.
ensure calls the internal pairFor helper to derive the trusted pair address.
The pair returned by pairFor is stored into local variable UNI in the modifier.
The derived UNI pair value participates in the require condition of ensure.
Parameter factory feeds the CREATE2 address computation in pairFor.
Parameter tokenA feeds the sorted token pair hash in pairFor.
Parameter tokenB feeds the sorted token pair hash in pairFor.
pairFor writes the derived address into the local variable pair.
Local token0 is used inside the keccak256 pair encoding.
Local token1 is used inside the keccak256 pair encoding.
Constructor parameter _name is assigned to the name state variable.
Constructor parameter _symbol is assigned to the symbol state variable.
Constructor parameter _supply is multiplied by 10**decimals without an overflow guard.
Constructor initializes the name state variable.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied amount.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged principal.
Constructor mints the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants an infinite allowance to the router address.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom performs the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
approve overwrites the allowance mapping entry for the caller and spender.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for the sender and each recipient.
batchSend performs the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
batchSend computes the local total from the unchecked product.
The local total variable directly feeds the unchecked balance subtraction.
Local index i drives the batchSend loop bounds over _tos.
batchSend assigns each _tos element to the local loop variable _to.
The loop local _to is used to credit balanceOf[_to].
An attacker-controlled delegatecall target can re-enter transferFrom during execution, mutating balances before state is settled.
